author: Ankit
problem: Given a non-empty list of quarterly profit figures, return the best one.
bug_description: Starts the running best at 0, so when every quarter lost money it returns 0 instead of the smallest loss.

comments.accurate: Returns the highest of the quarterly results
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the highest quarterly result, or 0 if no quarter made a profit
comments.wrong_location: Starting value verified; check that the comparison keeps the larger result
